_doc: Interaction -> deterministic query/view transformation. The chart is a living pivot table CONTAINED to its envelope: every gesture below rewrites query.task by rule, the server validates the result against the envelope + the query_task schema, and the SAME one executor runs it. No LLM at interaction time. Rejected = the gesture referenced a dim/fact/grain the envelope doesn't declare.

drill.gesture: click a chart mark (bar, cell, slice of a bar)
drill.query: APPEND where: {dimension: <clicked dim>, operator: eq, value: <clicked member>}; REPLACE dimensions: [<drill_to target>]
drill.view: re-run representation rules on the new shape (target dim cardinality decides bars_h vs bars_v); breadcrumb renders the where-chain, each crumb removable (un-drill = pop the predicate)
drill.example: spend by placement -> click 'Top of Search' -> products within Top of Search, spend + roas

pivot_dim.gesture: dimension selector in the card header
pivot_dim.query: REPLACE the categorical dimension with the chosen envelope dim (where-chain from drills is kept)

pivot_fact.gesture: metric selector in the card header
pivot_fact.query: no change when the fact is already in task.metrics; else REPLACE task.metrics primary
pivot_fact.view: y/sort swap to the chosen fact; invert-aware sort direction

regrain.query: REPLACE the temporal dimension: date <-> week <-> month (gold day grain; week/month are date_trunc at read — same table, never a different pull)
regrain.view: x swaps to the chosen grain

rerange.query: REPLACE task.time_range with the chosen preset/custom range (comparison.previous_period shifts with it automatically)

pin.effect: snapshot CURRENT {query, view, controls} into a card-definition (ad-dashboards-prebuilt schema/card-definition.schema.json) with a generated id; the chart joins the cockpit pin lifecycle exactly like a prebuilt card — a view the user pivoted into shape is pinned IN that shape

unpin.effect: removes the card from the cockpit stack; the definition stays on the Reports page until discarded

containment: an interaction may only reference keys present in envelope.facts / envelope.dims / envelope.grains — anything else is rejected before execution
drills compose: each drill appends one where predicate; the breadcrumb is the audit trail and the undo
widening beyond the envelope (new platform, new entity, unrelated dim) is NOT an interaction — it is a new prompt through the router, producing a new spec
